hypothesis_candidates.baseline: 100 percent cash-feasible core with no satellite risk budget.
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: On the current-enabled canonical-PIT panel, require at least five raw trades in every classic window; on the first session of each ISO week use only the prior 60 completed sessions, require at least five nonzero return sessions, rank by lowest absolute core correlation with lexical tie-breaks, select at most four exact-parent-child-disjoint sleeves, and assign capped inverse-volatility weights with 10 percent total and 5 percent per-sleeve caps. Hold residual capital as cash and never rank by mean return.
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: Information clocks across event, fundamental, macro and technical sleeves are asynchronous. A strictly lagged risk budget may reduce marginal portfolio variance and displacement cost when diversification changes more slowly than expected returns.
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: Weekly decisions using a 60-completed-session lookback across old_thin, mid_weak and late_strong.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: 100 percent cash-feasible core primary; static capped equal-risk and 90 percent core plus 10 percent cash diagnostics.
hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: Default-off only; total satellite <=10 percent NAV, each sleeve <=5 percent, at most four sleeves, exact parent-child exclusion, shared cash/cost calendar, no leverage, cash residual, weekly rebalance, no production orders, and fail-closed kill switch for missing state or hash drift.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: Park or reject if owner/novelty admission is absent, state transfer or source identity is incomplete, fewer than five executable weight changes occur in any standard window, overlap or concentration caps fail, or Gate 4-P fails against full core.

hypothesis_candidates.baseline: Current price-led candidate pool and full cash-feasible core.
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: Admit only genuinely point-in-time estimate-revision decisions whose independent evidence and next-session price transmission disagree with the market prior, with a frozen 20-session horizon and explicit same-day cash-conflict comparator.
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: Analyst expectation revisions can diffuse into prices over several sessions, but value exists only where the revision changes an executable cash-allocation decision rather than restating momentum.
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: 5, 10 and 20 sessions after the revision; formal readiness requires the 20-session window.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash-feasible core, cash, SPY, QQQ, and the unconditioned price-led candidate.
hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: Next-open cash equity only, top-one displacement, at most 5 percent NAV, no leverage, liquidity and overlap caps, default-off, missing consensus vintage fails closed.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: Park when H20 settled decisions are below 30, real cash conflicts below 10, or executable standard-window touches below 5/5/5; reject on no replacement-value transmission after those bars are met.

hypothesis_candidates.baseline: Current frozen exit lifecycle and unused slot held as cash.
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: Use predeclared advisory and hard-stop lifecycle severities to release a slot only when a machine-verifiable next-session replacement candidate exists, without changing the underlying entry ranker or exit thresholds.
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: Exit value is the avoided opportunity cost of stale capital, not merely the exited trade return; severity should transmit through a real executable replacement decision.
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: Next session replacement plus 5 and 20 session replacement-value settlement.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Frozen current exit policy, continued hold, cash, SPY, QQQ, and the actual replacement candidate.
hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: One released slot, no leverage, existing liquidity and exposure limits, default-off, no threshold retune, missing replacement timestamp fails closed.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: Park when hard-stop actions are below 33, advisory actions below 60, or executable touches below 5/5/5; reject if mature replacement value does not cover turnover and displacement cost.
